samples.column: WT NPC unsorted WT NPC Sox1 negative rep 2

rationale: GeCKO v2 hESC screen: day-7 NPCs sorted for the 1% lowest SOX1; guides enriched in SOX1-negative cells mark genes required for NPC differentiation. Each replicate's sorted and unsorted libraries come from one infection, so replicate is a blocking term (1 residual df). The third column header ('WT NPC unsorted WT NPC Sox1 negative rep 2') is garbled; it correlates 0.92 with unsorted rep 1 and has 0.5% zeros like it, so it is unsorted rep 2 (GSM5149488), and 'wt2_b1' (40% zeros, like the rep-1 sort) is SOX1-negative rep 2 (GSM5149489). The mapping rests on these correlations, not on labels.
